title: Throughput band definitions, autoscale remediation playbook, and contract clause drafts
creator: Asha Patel
description: Goal: Produce a single-sheeter and contract-ready clause set that defines measurable throughput bands (Nominal / Degraded / Severe), how error budget is computed across rolling windows, and the autoscale remediation playbook (automated + manual steps) for Dedicated customers. This ticket consolidates PM decisions, agreed measurement queries, legal language drafts, and the handoff to Eng for instrumentation and to Legal for final wording.
acceptance_criteria:
1) Document defines three throughput bands with numeric thresholds and examples for 1m/5m/1h windows.
2) Error budget math expressed as formula and example scenarios (credit calculation, credit burn, credit replenishment).
3) Contract clause draft such that Legal can insert into MSA with minimal edits.
4) Instrumentation spec for ENG (queries and labels) and a sample dashboard link.
5) Playbook runbook with automated triggers, paging criteria, and manual escalation steps.
6) Stakeholder signoff (Eng, Legal, SRE, Sales).
measurement_spec:
SLA target defined as percent of successful token-serve capacity relative to committed throughput. Measurement units: 'committed_tokens_per_minute' and 'served_tokens_per_minute'. Windows: 1 minute, 5 minute rolling, 1 hour rolling.
Formula: throughput_slo_pct = min(100, 100 * sum_over_window(served_tokens_per_minute) / sum_over_window(committed_tokens_per_minute)).
Error budget (window W) = max(0, (1 - SLO_target) * sum_over_W(committed_tokens_per_minute)).
Credit issuance: For incidents where throughput_slo_pct < SLO_target over billing_day, issue credits = prorated percentage of monthly committed fee proportional to average shortfall in the billing window, capped to X% per month (X defined in contract template).
Measurement tags: customer_id, model_variant, region, route_tag. Aggregation: aligned to UTC hourly buckets for billing and alerts use rolling windows for on-call detection.
contract_language_snippet:
CLIN 3. Throughput Commitments and Credits:
  3.1 Committed Throughput. Customer and Redwood agree a Committed Throughput (CT) expressed as tokens/minute. Redwood will operate Dedicated resources to provide CT with a Target Availability of 99.x% (TBD) measured over a calendar month.
  3.2 Degradation Bands. Service state is categorized as: Nominal (>= 100% of CT), Degraded (70% - 99% of CT), Severe (< 70% of CT). Credits apply when monthly average served throughput falls below CT.
  3.3 Measurement and Credit Calculation. Credits are computed by comparing served tokens to CT on a per-billing-window basis using the formula in Appendix A. Credits are the customer's exclusive remedy for throughput shortfalls, except for willful misconduct.
  3.4 Autoscale and Mitigation. Redwood will attempt automated scaling and fallback to compatible model variants per the Autoscale Policy before crediting. Customer shall be notified via the Console and email per the notification schedule in Section 5.
  3.5 Notice and Cure. Prior to any credit issuance, Redwood will provide notice and a 48-hour remediation window where practical. Emergency credits may be applied for critical incidents at Redwood's discretion.
  (Appendix A: Technical measurement formula and example calculations attached.)
rollout_plan:
Week 1: Align on numeric thresholds and SLO target with SRE and Sales.
Week 2: Draft contract clause and appendix, review with Legal.
Week 3: Instrumentation PR and dashboards (ENG-42109).
Week 4: Pilot with 2 existing Dedicated customers, collect real metrics, adjust thresholds.
Rollout gating: Legal signoff + instrumentation tests green + pilot SLO analysis within expected variance.
monitoring_queries: PromQL: sum by(customer_id) (rate(served_tokens_total[1m])) / sum by(customer_id) (committed_tokens_per_minute) * 100 -> used for 1m banding
PromQL: increase(served_tokens_total[1h]) / sum_over( committed_tokens_per_minute over 60 minutes ) -> used for monthly billing reconciliation
Alert rule: if 5m rolling throughput_slo_pct < 90% for >5m -> p1 page to SRE and PM on-call

2026-03-13 Sales (Rafael): Wants language that supports staged entitlements (burst vs sustained) so we can upsell burst packages. Agrees with Degraded/Severe banding.
